title: Phase 2 time reconciliation boundary
summary: Separate calendar date, local wall time, UTC instant, duration, observation period and validity bounds. Timezone, calendar and source event role are prerequisites for conversion. Employees 9999-01-01 is an open-ended validity sentinel; shift time lacks a date. A midnight string alone does not establish a UTC instant. Date-only native/source semantics can reuse core date; timestamp truncation needs an explicit query transformation.
